fee_notes: Single fee of $50,000, uniformly applied. 20% discount for honorably discharged veterans. Corporate agents may pay in two $25,000 installments (second may be waived). MBA Incentive Program participants may defer fee, fully waived if 300+ PIF in first full year.
raw_excerpt: For a single franchise, the Initial Franchise Fee will be $50,000, payable in full prior to beginning the initial training program.
